question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Through'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2 is:** 'Through'.**
 
• In this context, **"through"** is the best choice.
 
• The sentence reads: "In fact, water falling on 93% of Switzerland ultimately passes through at least one electric power plant before even leaving the country."
 
• **This implies** that the water flows or is conducted through power plants for energy generation.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: * 'In Switzerland these glacial meltwaters are used for hydropower. In fact, water falling on 93% of Switzerland ultimately passes **through **at least one electric power plant before even (3) __________ the country. So one consequence is that melting glaciers help to (4) __________ for low rainfall in times of drought, filling reservoirs to supply the nation's (5) __________ supply.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options are not the correct answer:
 
 
• **'For' **- This would suggest a purpose or a goal, but doesn't accurately describe the physical process of water flowing through a power plant.
 
• **'With'** - This suggests association or combination, which doesn't accurately portray the process being described here.
 
• **'Beneath' **- This preposition would mean that the water is flowing underneath the power plants, which is not what the sentence is trying to convey.
